title: Where is Foundation's executable?
summary: The framework bundle exists in the FileSystem image, while its executable image is indexed inside the SystemOS dyld shared cache.

title: How much of Foundation's method surface is indexed?
summary: An exact-cache class dump yields 11,045 Objective-C method entries across 720 classes and 53 categories, with all IMP addresses checked against the image's code segment.

title: What does the per-image Objective-C method catalog cover?
summary: All 4,170 exact iOS cache images yield 3,065,801 static Objective-C method entries. Empty dumps and unknown selectors remain explicit; the index is a horizontal metadata inventory.

title: Which named code symbols are visible across the iOS cache?
summary: All 4,170 exact iOS cache images yield 6,585,655 unique named __text records in 3,798 images; 372 have no matching names. Symbol names complement, but overlap with, Objective-C methods.

title: Which cache frameworks have sourced introductions?
summary: Apple framework documentation now supplies linked introductions for 213 of 227 exact top-level framework images. Other cache images retain metadata overviews while functional research continues.

title: What function names are visible in the DriverKit cache?
summary: All 51 DriverKit images yield 65,668 unique named __text symbol records. The ObjC class dumps list no classes or methods; symbols are not a complete function inventory.

title: Which Mach-O files exist outside the dyld caches?
summary: Three official system images contain 3,363 physical Mach-O files with exact file hashes, types, architectures, and UUIDs. Two mixed Metal containers remain explicit exclusions.

title: What Objective-C methods are visible in standalone Mach-O files?
summary: An exact-file pass over all 3,363 standalone Mach-O files yields 847,771 static Objective-C method entries. Explicit zero results remain distinct from a complete function inventory.

title: Which named code symbols are visible in standalone Mach-O files?
summary: An exact-file pass over all 3,363 standalone Mach-O files yields 323,061 unique named __text records in 1,200 files. Symbol names complement ObjC methods but do not enumerate every function.

title: What Swift metadata is visible in standalone Mach-O files?
summary: All 3,363 exact standalone files were checked: 1,295 have Swift sections, yielding 282,145 declaration and 294,746 member or requirement lines. 133 outputs are explicitly partial.

title: What is inside the two kernelcaches?
summary: The release and research artifacts share a build but have distinct Mach-O UUIDs. Fileset entries and kext metadata count different structures.

title: Where does SpringBoard's entry point lead?
summary: A stock launchd plist points to a disk executable whose entry thunk imports a SpringBoard.framework function present in the dyld shared cache.

title: Where are SpringBoard's lifecycle entry points?
summary: The intact cache identifies SpringBoard's startup selectors, class relationships, and framework dependencies; function ordering remains to be verified.

title: What happens before SpringBoard enters UIKit?
summary: Selected instructions in the exact cache image show conditional build and snapshot handling, early initialization, and a direct branch from SBSystemAppMain to UIApplicationMain.

title: How much of SpringBoard.framework's method surface is indexed?
summary: An exact-cache class dump yields 52,025 Objective-C method entries across 2,633 classes and 108 categories, with all IMP addresses checked against the image's code segment.

title: Why does Foundation reach more images with weak loads?
summary: An exact-cache graph links Foundation to 123 images without weak loads and 1,353 when weak declarations are included.

title: What does stock versus device actually compare?
summary: All 430,719 published device path/type pairs match the official FileSystem image; 4,133 paths from separate stock images have no same-path record in the filtered /rootfs view.
